intended_counts.occurrence_identity: clock_empty and clock_parent each 1..1000 under no parent. Each clock_child has occurrence 1 under its distinct parent token; do not require global child occurrence 1..1000.
intended_counts.span_tokens_if_full: 0..2999; one token per begun span with both endpoint pairs
intended_counts.count_derivation: 3000 spans * 2 endpoint pairs + 1 call * 2 endpoint pairs = 6002 pairs; wall then CPU for every pair.

review_rules.rule: First require exact source/interpreter/environment/origin/owner identity and full artifact audit. Unknown/missing identity is incomplete; exit zero alone is insufficient.

Only compare observed population to intended 1 call/3000 spans and named 1000/1000/1000 groups after reading raw slots. Validate unique worker/call/token/begin/end identities, parent graph, disjoint standalone spans and child-in-parent sequence. Child occurrence resets under each parent.

For a full mechanics candidate, require 6002 available wall and 6002 CPU integer endpoints, wall-before-CPU code order and nondecreasing observed sequence, no open span/call, complete exits/coverage and no faults. Coarse equal endpoints/zero intervals are retained; do not invent a minimum duration.

Preserve every signed inclusive/exclusive result; independently recompute using only complete immediate children. Missing/partial means unknown, never zero. Negative residuals/anomalies/faults remain explicit and block clean-mechanics status; this record supplies no tolerance.

Validate sidecar-export completeness/file SHA and parent/resource/import logs. Clock branch normally has raw_not_returned true, null simulation fields, allowance_status unresolved and observer_validity incomplete. Distinguish complete population/export from scientific observer-validity.

Any timeout, signal, overflow, unclosed token, unsupported clock value, export/storage or origin/isolation error makes attempt incomplete/invalid. Preserve all reached raw slots, pair halves, partials, exit/log and guard; missing record is missing, never inferred success. No discard/rerun/favorable replacement.

No physical work exists: no physical completion/authority or stopping claim. Host interrupted/censored tail remains unknown, even if partial lower bound can be read; do not repurpose it as physical latency.

Engineering and Primary separately decide whether observations justify any allowance or expose recorder unsuitability. No automatic allowance or negative-time clamp, no NMPC result, improvement, end-to-end latency, native-thread-control or broader-G2 acceptance claim.
